admission.justification: Empty-family admission spans worklist extraction in writer.py, state propagation in authoring.py, dual-side emptiness validation in family_rows.py, and FamilyRow validation in authoring_rows.py, and only the focused writer-gate alignment tests distinguish dual-side emptiness from memory-HEAD or single-side checks.

applicability: Family history rows authored through knowledge_write on converted memory
conditions: The persisted leaf knowledge-worklist.json contains a reached_family item for the named family whose facts.members list is empty
The candidate family record after record writes in the same batch also has an empty members list
Family status (active or retired) is not used to gate empty-examined admission
exclusions: Family rows without a persisted worklist or without a reached_family item for that family, which keep the existing refusal
Empty families that gain a member in the same handoff batch, which must examine that member

evidence: Reviewer Code R1 PASS: notes/reports/reviewer/e6d511f4-f94d-5c9b-8cf1-a45e916c3faf/role-launch/261112-BUG-L57-R1-code-verdict.md; 6 functions / 11 collected cases in the new module and 305 focused tests passed on tree 2906df6934a6; full leaf gate and family_row_open accept the empty-family rows and the refusal cases keep the present message.

statement: knowledge_write admits an empty or omitted examined list on a family history row only when the persisted worklist's reached_family item for that family has an empty members list and the produced family record after the write also has no members, regardless of family status.
title: Empty examined admitted only when reached family is empty at both sides
